4-MODUL MUQOVASI, O'NG BET (raqamsiz, pdf 100).

Yuqorida o'ngda TO'Q SARIQ oval: yashil 'Module 4', 'Units 13-15'. To'q sariq strelka 'Learn how to ...': • give directions • express likes/dislikes • arrange to meet someone • express reactions • make comments. Strelka 'Practise ...': • infinitive/-ing form • say/tell • reported statements • reported questions • question tags • exclamations • reported orders/instructions.

Chapda KO'K qiya sarlavha 'Surf the Net!' - ko'k oval 'Unit 15'. SURATLAR: kompyuter oldida o'g'il va qiz; pastda 'BAD LINK', '404', 'CONNECTION LOST', 'TOO MANY USERS', 'SLOW CONNECTION', 'SERVER NOT RESPONDING' yozuvlari orasida rul ushlab hayajonlangan erkak. Nuqtalar: • technology • computers • the Internet.

  express reactions = munosabat

  reported questions = ko'chirma
